fields.snapshot: JSON of entire previous plans row

fields.minutes: integer active minutes >=0; rest may be excluded

dateRules.timestamps: Client inputs explicitly offset +09:00; persisted UTC; rendered Asia/Seoul
dateRules.period: filter task.due inclusive; all logs belonging to included tasks count

aggregation.planCount: nondeleted tasks in selected plan and due-date period
aggregation.blocked: distinct included tasks with one or more nonblank logs.blocker
aggregation.actual: sum all logs.minutes for included tasks

consistency.planEdit: optimistic version check and previous snapshot insert + update in atomic D1 batch
consistency.completion: explicit desired boolean state; UPDATE plus INSERT ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING or DELETE in atomic batch; task_id PK prevents double count
consistency.logRetry: same log UUID reused on retry; ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
consistency.review: next plan and review persisted in atomic batch with stable UUIDs
consistency.delete: soft delete task; excluded from statistics, retained with related logs in export
consistency.sorting: selected field, then created ASC, then id ASC

security.secrets: none in application; DB binding is server-only
security.auth: no application login; public shared data
